summary: Generate typed session-scoped client-control grant lifecycle resources and injectable TypeScript SHA-256

replay.detail: Wire schema and client decoder sources only; this fragment does not change claim replay.

schema.detail: Adds client-control-grant-lifecycle Resource with grant/run/device/session/item binding, started/ended/revoked state, reason and monotonic sequence on existing commands snapshot/changes frames.

rules.detail: Lifecycle rows drive indicators and termination, not command policy. Decoders reject sequence zero and values above 2^53-1 before ordering checks. Bound item IDs must match; stale valid started rows are ignored; terminal grants cannot reactivate; commands without active lifecycle state fail closed.

compatibility.detail: Rust, Swift and TypeScript decode the lifecycle resource through generated Resource arms. Older clients preserve the unknown resource. TypeScript canonical helpers accept injected raw-byte SHA-256 for Hermes and expose ClientResultCanonicalizationError with invalid-unicode code; canonical bytes remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No live setup, enrollment or daemon operation is performed by these source changes.

manual.detail: Integrate source layers before one cargo run -p fractal-client-codegen. Shared lifecycle resources, frames and fail-closed traces are checked by client tests.

recovery.detail: No stored data migration is introduced by generated lifecycle decoder source.
